stem.en: A tool splits "unbelievable" into un + believ + able. Which conclusion is fair?

text.en: This is the only correct way to split the word
Those pieces were common in the text it counted
The tool knows that the piece un means not
Long words always split into exactly three tokens

explanation.en: The list comes from counting pieces in text, so the split shows what was common there. A list counted from other text can split the same word differently, and no meaning was involved.
